integrity: Rational computations and the all-parameter mathematical proof are contained in the package. Self-review only; no independent audit or validation.
scientific_limitations: Magic and ordinary Ehrhart positivity are classified only for the polars associated with K_{2,m}; no claim on generic K_{a,b}, Ehrhart numerator roots, or historical priority certification. The finite K_{2,m} cases m<=11 and the Bernoulli obstruction in the order-polytope setting are prior work.
title: Sharp magic-positivity threshold for complete-bipartite polar edge polytopes
